summary: Every course must be letter graded. With no subplan you follow the General Track: one political philosophy and one moral philosophy course of 4-5 units, two or three ETHICSOC courses at the 100 level totaling 8 units, and two or three university-wide 100-level courses with ethical content totaling 8 units, each of at least 3 units. The Ethics and Technology subplan instead needs one moral or political philosophy course, one ethics and technology course and one ETHICSOC elective of 4-5 units each, and three Ethics and Technology electives of at least 3 units totaling 8 units. The Student Services Specialist approves elective choices and unlisted courses, which are moved in by hand, and your advisor checks that no course also counts toward another program.
